scope: Provenance record for the HaGRID/Ultralytics hand detector. The model is NOT bundled in releases; users download it separately.

hand_yolov8n.onnx.notes: ONNX metadata identifies an Ultralytics YOLOv8n export. The AGPL-3.0 licence conflicts with the repository's Apache-2.0; therefore the model is excluded from PyInstaller packaging. Users who want the hagrid_yolo engine or engine_auto_switch feature must download and export the model themselves (see README). Local development use is not blocked.
